title: [Bug] API Error 500 on every prompt - Claude Max completely unusable
body:
## Bug Description

Claude Code returns a 500 Internal Server Error on **every single prompt**. The tool is completely unusable — no requests succeed. This is on the **Claude Max ($200/month) plan**.

## Error Message

```
API Error: 500
{"type":"error","error":{"type":"api_error","message":"Internal server error"},"request_id":"req_011CYV9uG7uP4D1i3S8okZFo"}
```

## Environment

- **OS**: macOS
- **Claude Code version**: 2.1.56
- **Plan**: Claude Max ($200/month)
- **Started**: February 24, 2026 (ongoing as of filing)
- **Frequency**: 100% of prompts — not intermittent, completely broken

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open terminal
2. Run `claude`
3. Send any prompt
4. Receive 500 error every time

## What I've Tried

- Restarting Claude Code
- Starting new conversations
- Different prompts (simple and complex)

## Impact

Paying $200/month for a service that is returning server errors on every request. Cannot do any work.

## Notes

This appears related to the wave of 500 errors reported in #27559, #27635, #22838, and #23111. Multiple users are experiencing the same issue in February 2026.
author: JarvisOnM4
